text.p: Novellus Systems Inc., a maker of equipment to manufacture computer chips, said Monday it has acquired the thin films systems business of Varian Associates Inc. for about $150 million in cash.

The assets and employees of the business will become part of Novellus' newly created Metals Business Group, the company said. The acquisition offers the potential to nearly double Novellus' market, it said.
Novellus systems are designed for high-volume production of high-quality semiconductors at low cost.
Novellus, based in San Jose, Calif., also has subsidiaries in Britain, France, Germany, the Netherlands, China, Japan, Korea, Singapore and Taiwan.
Novellus stock jumped $2.875 to $83.69 on Nasdaq in afternoon trading. Varian rose 50 cents to $53.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
